objective: Reduce median per-action controller wall time on the already exposed Build 001 reproduction surface while preserving immutable evidence, deterministic replay, bounded deep reasoning, and the frozen synthetic mechanism floors.

source_freeze.resolution: The implementation and measurement commits descend from the baseline above. The unique Stage 07 attempt is never rerun, resumed, completed, or overwritten.
permitted_changes: typed two-speed cadence, receipts, checkpoint state, and pure caches
failure-preserving public evaluator cleanup and sealing
tests and a fail-closed Stage 08 measurement harness

always_on_evidence_fold: raw returned consequence and observation receipts
immutable transition preservation and mechanics membership
local hypothesis support, contradiction, and reopening
fast_path: pure cache lookup keyed by complete immutable identities
continuation of an already validated current plan
generic probe or explicit deterministic fallback when no current plan is usable
separations: candidate hypothesis is not accepted rule
goal hypothesis is not permission to act
cache value is derived computation and never authority
elapsed time is telemetry and never a policy-selection input
a successful consequence never rewrites a prior hypothesis as known

typed_cadence.trigger_authority: Every trigger is derived from the current typed state plus immutable receipt IDs or observation/state digests. Trigger ordering and integer counters are deterministic and checkpointed.

operation_budgets.retrodicted_transitions: at most the current mechanics epoch membership, itself bounded by max_actions
operation_budgets.deep_invocations: at most initial observation plus one completed consequence per permitted environment action

typed_cadence.timeout_rule: A wall envelope may terminate an experiment or produce an explicit fault/fallback receipt. It may not choose the current, partial, or best-so-far action silently. Policy path choice uses only deterministic evidence and integer budgets.

receipt_contract.action_linkage: Every action.selected receipt links to the completed reasoning receipt for the observation available before acting.
receipt_contract.deep_completeness: Every deep selection has exactly one terminal completed or fallback receipt before an action crosses the adapter boundary.

cache_contract.policy: deterministic bounded LRU with checkpointed access order when hits can affect performed work
key_fields: ordered model semantic identities and rank weights
cache_contract.value_boundary: Only pure predictions, goal/progress projections, and reusable plan values may be cached. Trace IDs, receipt IDs, hypothesis acceptance, permission, and environment consequences may not be cached as authority.
required_invalidations: model promotion, suspension, demotion, or reopening
cache_contract.collision_rule: A digest match is insufficient; the complete canonical key must match before reuse.

mechanics_capacity_repair.problem: Stage 07 proved that the fixed 64-transition per-epoch bound faults a valid 80-action run on its 65th non-reset consequence.
mechanics_capacity_repair.decision: Make the lifecycle capacity an instance contract equal to the config-hashed max_actions for the run. Persist it, verify it against the current context during restore, and register membership before mutating other derived transition collections.
forbidden_repairs: dropping or compacting immutable raw receipts
a second independently configurable transition-budget knob
raising a global constant only for the observed 80-action case
acceptance: all five retrodiction modes cross 64 transitions under an 80-action budget
exact-limit and overflow behavior is tested
genuine evidence-driven epoch changes retain the same capacity

authority_boundaries_retained: after action.submitted and before adapter execution
after consequence evidence and derived-state update
checkpoint_contract.reason: The current restore path requires the latest checkpoint commitment at the trace tail and has no general trace-forward state fold. Cadence does not authorize dropping either exactly-once boundary.
checkpoint_contract.reasoning_state: Cadence counters, last structural identity, no-progress streak, cache entries and order, and last completed deliberation linkage are typed checkpoint state and are revalidated from the trace or recomputed before reuse.
checkpoint_contract.mid_deliberation: A checkpoint is never accepted as a completed reasoning boundary while deliberation is in progress.

measurement_protocol.order: deterministic balanced rotation by repetition; identical game, seed, action/reset/wall/search/coordinate budgets and profiler mode
measurement_protocol.primary_metric: median paired per-action whole-controller wall time over normally returned action/consequence boundaries; separately report censored and failed rows
measurement_protocol.materiality: TWO_SPEED must reduce the primary median by at least 25 percent against both FROZEN_BUILD_000_FULL and BUILD_001_LEGACY_ALWAYS_DEEP, with at least 70 percent of paired cells non-regressing.
measurement_protocol.behavior_boundary: Timing success cannot override different actions, terminal status, score, faults, or receipt integrity. Report those outcomes separately and never let a timeout or exception masquerade as a faster completed action.
required_measurements: choose, consequence, checkpoint, and total wall and CPU time per action
prediction, compilation, retrodiction, simulation, and search work counts
environment actions, resets, levels, terminal status, and score
source, config, asset, seed, hardware, runtime, and package identities

frozen_regression_floors.stage_13_build_000_exact: 2/2 completions in at most 8 total actions with semantic trace, replay, and checkpoint verification
frozen_regression_floors.stage_14_full: at least 8/14 completions and at most 157 total actions
frozen_regression_floors.stage_14_component_gaps: A4 without world-model simulation completes at most 1/14 and A5 without goal inference completes 0/14, preserving FULL advantages of at least 7 and 8 completions respectively
frozen_regression_floors.palette_equivariance: 256/256 declared procedural pairs and 16/16 checkpoint pairs
frozen_regression_floors.action_equivariance: 128/128 declared procedural pairs, 528/528 post-calibration inverse requests, and 16/16 checkpoint pairs
frozen_regression_floors.rule_change: preserve 32/32 action-effect rotations and report the frozen traversability/noise failures honestly; do not weaken the original causal gates
frozen_regression_floors.replay: deterministic repeat plus checkpoint restore at both FAST and DEEP boundaries, exact next path/action, and tamper rejection
frozen_regression_floors.integrity: offline production, zero hosted inference, zero game-ID/action-table findings, zero holdout events or locally acquired holdout assets

resource_floors.note: Resource violations are reported as FAILED_MECHANISM or FAILED_INFRASTRUCTURE according to cause; thresholds are not changed after observation.

decision_rule.PASS: The materiality gate, regression floors, receipt completeness, checkpoint/replay, resource bounds, static integrity, artifact verification, and sealed-holdout checks all pass.
decision_rule.PARTIAL: A typed and reproducible two-speed system exists but one or more acceptance gates are not met without a decisive mechanism contradiction.
decision_rule.FAILED_MECHANISM: The two-speed mechanism fails material timing, behavior, regression, deterministic replay, or resource criteria under a valid execution.
decision_rule.FAILED_INFRASTRUCTURE: The declared comparison cannot execute or serialize because of tooling, unavailable resources, or a harness defect; preserve partial evidence and continue independent stages.
decision_rule.production_on_failure: Retain the strongest integrity-preserving deterministic configuration supported by completed evidence. A failed timing gate does not authorize evidence loss, holdout exposure, or return to the fixed transition defect.
